AnalysisInput.description:
One input of an analysis, named by reference and mounted read-only at `/in/<name>`. Exactly one
of `artifact_id`, `dataset_view` or `conditions` is set. The host resolves the reference under
the caller's scope (every partition check applies, also to the lineage of an artifact), copies
the bytes and verifies their digest; the request never carries the data itself. The runner never
sees the host filesystem or other stores. `/job/inputs.json` lists the mounted inputs
([`MountedInput`]) for the program.

artifact_id.description: An artifact of the caller's workspace (e.g. the output of an earlier analysis).

conditions.description:
The complete answer of a `conditions_query` (every page), as one `ConditionsTable` JSON
document; `cursor` must be absent.

dataset_view.description: One columnar view (Parquet) of a curated dataset, as `datasets_inspect` lists it.

name.description: File name under `/in` (`[A-Za-z0-9._-]`, not starting with `.`).

AnalysisLanguage.description:
Language of an `analysis_execute` program. Closed: a new value needs a runner image that
provides it (and a preflight that proves it).

oneOf.description: CPython of the pinned runner image, run isolated (`python -I`).

AtmosphereTarget.description:
`ConditionsQuery::near`: a named crew atmosphere, or explicit oxygen and pressure bounds
(a point when min = max).

ConditionFilter.description:
A filter on one key. A filter keeps rows whose cell is a value inside it; rows whose cell is
missing or conflicting are kept only with `ConditionsQuery::include_unknown`.

ConditionKey.description:
A condition the challenge and the graph join on. Numeric keys are stored in the SI unit of their
[`Quantity`]; the others are categorical text (`n-heptane`, `flat sheet`, `CIR/MDCA`). The
catalog is closed: a new key is a contract change.

ConditionsQuery.description: `conditions_query`: per-run conditions and, on request, each investigation's tested envelope.

near.description:
Rank the matching rows by how near their ambient oxygen and pressure are to this target,
nearest first (each row then carries `nearness`). Rows without both values are left out.

CrewAtmosphere.description: A crew atmosphere named by the Flame in Freefall challenge.

oneOf.description: Moon base and rovers: oxygen ≥ 30 % at 4.3–10.2 psi (29.6–70.3 kPa).
ISS and Earth: 21 % oxygen at 14.7 psi (101.3 kPa).
C0. Still read; new documents are written as v2.

DatasetViewRef.description: A view of a dataset bundle by name.

description:
Argument of `analysis_execute`: a program run once in the isolated runner (no network, read-only
root, separate uid, no host secrets). Its stdout, stderr and the regular files it writes under
`/out` become artifacts of an [`ExecutionRecord`].

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key: a retry with the same key returns the same job.
